plaatsen.tekst: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile
If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one
No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk
